mapper.insert: INSERT into mall_order ( id, order_no, store_id, user_id, openid, app_id, mch_id, contact, address, remark, goods_amount, delivery_fee, promo_id, promo_discount, user_coupon_id, coupon_discount, discount_amount, discount_desc, pay_amount, pay_amount_fen, pay_channel, member_priced, pay_status, prepay_id, created_by, created_time, deleted ) value ( #{id}, #{orderNo}, #{storeId}, #{userId}, #{openid}, #{appId}, #{mchId}, #{contact}, #{address}, #{remark}, #{goodsAmount}, #{deliveryFee}, #{promoId}, #{promoDiscount}, #{userCouponId}, #{couponDiscount}, #{discountAmount}, #{discountDesc}, #{payAmount}, #{payAmountFen}, #{payChannel}, #{memberPriced}, #{payStatus}, #{prepayId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdTime}, #{deleted} )
mapper.select: select * from mall_order where order_no = #{orderNo} and deleted = 0 limit 1
mapper.update: update mall_order set pay_status = 1, transaction_id = #{transactionId}, paid_time = #{paidTime}, update_time = #{paidTime} where order_no = #{orderNo} and pay_status = 0 and deleted = 0
update mall_order set prepay_id = #{prepayId}, update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and deleted = 0

update mall_order set wx_shipping_status = #{status}, wx_shipping_errcode = #{errcode}, wx_shipping_errmsg = #{errmsg}, wx_shipping_retry = #{retry}, wx_shipping_time = #{shippingTime}, update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and deleted = 0
mapper.select: select * from mall_order where deleted = 0 and pay_status = 1 and (wx_shipping_status is null or wx_shipping_status in (0, 2)) and ifnull(wx_shipping_retry, 0) < #{maxRetry} order by paid_time asc, id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update mall_order set pay_status = 3, pending_refund_fen = #{pendingRefundFen}, out_refund_no = #{outRefundNo}, refund_reason = #{reason}, refund_by = #{refundBy}, update_by = #{refundBy}, update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and deleted = 0 and pay_status in (1, 4)

update mall_order set refund_amount_fen = ifnull(refund_amount_fen, 0) + #{refundFen}, refund_amount = round(refund_amount_fen / 100, 2), pending_refund_fen = null, wx_refund_id = #{wxRefundId}, out_refund_no = #{outRefundNo}, refund_time = #{refundTime}, pay_status = case when refund_amount_fen >= ifnull(pay_amount_fen, 0) then 5 else 4 end, update_time = #{refundTime} where order_no = #{orderNo} and deleted = 0 and ( (pay_status = 3 and out_refund_no = #{outRefundNo}) or (pay_status in (1, 4) and #{allowDirect} = 1) ) and ifnull(refund_amount_fen, 0) + #{refundFen} <= ifnull(pay_amount_fen, 0)

update mall_order set pending_refund_fen = null, pay_status = case when ifnull(refund_amount_fen, 0) <= 0 then 1 when ifnull(refund_amount_fen, 0) >= ifnull(pay_amount_fen, 0) then 5 else 4 end, update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and deleted = 0 and pay_status = 3 and out_refund_no = #{outRefundNo}
mapper.select: select * from mall_order where out_refund_no = #{outRefundNo} and deleted = 0 limit 1

select period, sum(orderCount) as orderCount, sum(payAmount) as payAmount, sum(refundAmount) as refundAmount, sum(netAmount) as netAmount from ( select case when #{periodType} = 'year' then date_format(paid_time, '%Y') when #{periodType} = 'quarter' then concat(year(paid_time), '-Q', quarter(paid_time)) when #{periodType} = 'month' then date_format(paid_time, '%Y-%m') else date_format(paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d') end as period, count(*) as orderCount, ifnull(sum(pay_amount), 0) as payAmount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(refund_amount, 0)), 0) as refundAmount, ifnull(sum(pay_amount - ifnull(refund_amount, 0)), 0) as netAmount from mall_order where deleted = 0 and store_id = #{storeId} and paid_time is not null and paid_time >= #{startTime} and paid_time < #{endTime} and pay_status in (1, 3, 4, 5) and ifnull(pay_channel, 1) = 1 group by 1 union all select case when #{periodType} = 'year' then date_format(paid_time, '%Y') when #{periodType} = 'quarter' then concat(year(paid_time), '-Q', quarter(paid_time)) when #{periodType} = 'month' then date_format(paid_time, '%Y-%m') else date_format(paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d') end as period, count(*) as orderCount, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as payAmount, 0 as refundAmount, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as netAmount from store_member_recharge where deleted = 0 and store_id = #{storeId} and paid_time is not null and paid_time >= #{startTime} and paid_time < #{endTime} and pay_status = 1 group by 1 ) t group by period order by period

select ifnull(( select sum(pay_amount - ifnull(refund_amount, 0)) from mall_order where deleted = 0 and store_id = #{storeId} and paid_time is not null and pay_status in (1, 4) and ifnull(pay_channel, 1) = 1 and ifnull(settle_status, 0) = 0 and (pay_amount - ifnull(refund_amount, 0)) > 0 ), 0) + ifnull(( select sum(amount) from store_member_recharge where deleted = 0 and store_id = #{storeId} and paid_time is not null and pay_status = 1 and ifnull(settle_status, 0) = 0 and amount > 0 ), 0) as pendingAmount, ifnull(( select sum(pay_amount - ifnull(refund_amount, 0)) from mall_order where deleted = 0 and store_id = #{storeId} and paid_time is not null and paid_time >= #{startTime} and paid_time < #{endTime} and pay_status in (1, 3, 4, 5) and ifnull(pay_channel, 1) = 1 ), 0) + ifnull(( select sum(amount) from store_member_recharge where deleted = 0 and store_id = #{storeId} and paid_time is not null and paid_time >= #{startTime} and paid_time < #{endTime} and pay_status = 1 ), 0) as todayIncome

select storeId, storeName, orderCount, pendingAmount, lastPaidTime, lastSettleTime from ( select storeId, storeName, sum(orderCount) as orderCount, sum(pendingAmount) as pendingAmount, max(lastPaidTime) as lastPaidTime, max(lastSettleTime) as lastSettleTime from ( select o.store_id as storeId, s.store_name as storeName, ifnull(sum(case when ifnull(o.settle_status, 0) = 0 and o.pay_status in (1, 4) and ifnull(o.pay_channel, 1) = 1 and (o.pay_amount - ifnull(o.refund_amount, 0)) > 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as orderCount, ifnull(sum(case when ifnull(o.settle_status, 0) = 0 and o.pay_status in (1, 4) and ifnull(o.pay_channel, 1) = 1 and (o.pay_amount - ifnull(o.refund_amount, 0)) > 0 then o.pay_amount - ifnull(o.refund_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as pendingAmount, date_format(max(case when o.pay_status in (1, 4) and ifnull(o.pay_channel, 1) = 1 and (o.pay_amount - ifnull(o.refund_amount, 0)) > 0 then o.paid_time end), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastPaidTime, date_format(max(case when o.settle_status = 1 then o.settle_time end), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastSettleTime from mall_order o left join store s on s.store_id = o.store_id and s.deleted = 0 where o.deleted = 0 and o.paid_time is not null and o.pay_status in (1, 3, 4, 5)
and o.store_id = #{storeId}
and s.store_name like concat('%', #{storeName}, '%')
group by o.store_id, s.store_name union all select r.store_id as storeId, s.store_name as storeName, ifnull(sum(case when ifnull(r.settle_status, 0) = 0 and r.pay_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as orderCount, ifnull(sum(case when ifnull(r.settle_status, 0) = 0 and r.pay_status = 1 then r.amount else 0 end), 0) as pendingAmount, date_format(max(case when r.pay_status = 1 then r.paid_time end), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastPaidTime, date_format(max(case when r.settle_status = 1 then r.settle_time end), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastSettleTime from store_member_recharge r left join store s on s.store_id = r.store_id and s.deleted = 0 where r.deleted = 0 and r.paid_time is not null and r.pay_status = 1
and r.store_id = #{storeId}
and s.store_name like concat('%', #{storeName}, '%')
group by r.store_id, s.store_name ) u group by storeId, storeName ) t
t.pendingAmount <= 0 and t.lastSettleTime is not null
t.pendingAmount > 0
order by
t.lastSettleTime desc, t.storeId desc
t.pendingAmount desc, t.storeId desc
mapper.update: update mall_order set settle_status = 1, settle_time = #{settleTime}, settle_by = #{settleBy}, update_time = #{settleTime}, update_by = #{settleBy} where deleted = 0 and store_id = #{storeId} and ifnull(settle_status, 0) = 0 and ifnull(pay_channel, 1) = 1 and pay_status in (1, 4, 5)
